programs.description: A young, vivacious and educated woman named Gauri does her bit to support her ageing father in his endeavours to write a book and constantly assists those who need her help in reading and writing.
After a child princess is gifted a harmonium, she soon gets orphaned, then widowed and lastly left penniless. After the harmonium is sold, it brings bad luck to whomsoever owns it.
A mother-in-law treats her daughters-in-law, Mamta, Tandra and Deepa, according to their husband's income. However, when she falls ill, she realises her folly.
When a girl does not return home from work on time, her family tries to look for her. However, when she does not return all night, they receive flak from the residents of their building.
After a failing streak, a director chooses to take on a romantic film. However, the perfect book sets him on the path to finding the mysterious novelist to make a successful movie.

A comprehensive compilation of some of the best devotional songs by various artists in praise of the various gods and goddesses.
A subject-matter expert conducts an informative lecture on songs composed by Rabindranath Tagore with suitable examples in a detailed and easy-to-understand manner.
Narsingh, a taxi driver, decides to return to his native place, but finds himself involved with a businessman en route, who is also a smuggler and human trafficker.
Gopal Bhar is appointed as a jester in Raja Krishnachandra's court in medieval Bengal. His wit and humour are well-known in the region and his exploits always have a significant social message.
A terminally ill man doubts his wife's faithfulness, but realises regretfully that he was mistaken. She decides to forgive him, and puts on stage performances to fund his treatment.
While pursuing further studies in Kolkata, Indrani falls for Sudarshan, and the couple gets married. However, their relationship turns sour because of their conflicting thoughts.
Anulekha, neglected by her filmmaker husband Palash, finds solace in reading. Her solitary life takes an unexpected turn when Animesh, a writer, suddenly appears at her door one evening.
A wealthy businessman's son, Prasanta, dreams of becoming a famous singer. But when his ambition guides him to Kolkata, love is waiting for him around the corner.
